title: Chunk assembler verifies SHA-256 manifest and writes only on full success
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag buffering the whole payload in memory as wasteful, or the temp-file rename as needless ceremony. Buffering until every hash verifies is what makes the never-write-a-partial guarantee possible, and the atomic rename ensures a concurrent reader never observes a half-written output file.
